items.prompt: A root 5 has a right child 5. What result does the strict BST contract require?

options.text: INVALID, because the right inequality is strict.
options.why: Equal values violate value>lower for a right descendant.

options.text: VALID, because equal values may always go right.
options.why: Some BST policies permit duplicates, but this task explicitly does not.

options.text: VALID, provided the tree has only two nodes.
options.why: Tree size does not weaken strict ordering.

options.text: INVALID only if the two nodes have the same index.
options.why: Different indexes do not make equal keys strictly ordered.

items.explanation: Equal values violate value>lower for a right descendant.
